title: Quality gates metrics draft (Optimize gating) — metric names/tags, queries, alert candidates
content:
Owner: Allison Grant (SRE/Observability)
Last reviewed with: Sergio Costa, Sean Gallagher
Context: Optimize “quality guardrails gating” requires mandatory eval checks before batching/cache/quantization changes can be applied. We need consistent metrics + tags across Optimize service, eval-harness, and rollout-controller so we can: (1) measure reliability of gating, (2) detect quality regressions, (3) avoid paging on flaky eval suites.

This is a working draft. Canonical spec should land in Confluence: “quality-gates-observability-standard”.

---

1) Goals (what we need to answer quickly)

A. Is the gating system healthy?
- Are gate runs starting/completing?
- Are we hitting timeouts / capacity issues (esp. region-specific)?
- Are retries spiking?

B. Are gates effective (catching regressions without blocking safe changes)?
- Pass/fail rates by config type + model family + GPU SKU
- Distribution of “delta quality metrics” and confidence

C. Are results trustworthy (flake detection)?
- Flake score trends
- Quarantine rate of prompt sets / suites
- Rerun frequency and disagreement rate between reruns

D. Are we harming developer experience (gates too slow / too expensive)?
- Gate execution latency p50/p95/p99 by tier (smoke vs full)
- Eval compute cost proxy (GPU-minutes) per gate run
- Backlog/queue depth for eval jobs

E. Is enforcement actually happening?
- Apply attempts blocked due to gate failure
- Canary promotions blocked/halted due to gate failure
- Override requests vs overrides granted, and whether overrides correlate with later incidents

---

2) Naming conventions

Metric prefix:
- optimize_quality_gate_* : emitted from Optimize service / control plane
- eval_harness_quality_gate_* : emitted from eval-harness
- rollout_quality_gate_* : emitted from rollout controller

Type conventions:
- *_total counters
- *_duration_ms histogram
- *_gauge gauges for queue depth / concurrency

Label/tag conventions (keep cardinality bounded):

Required labels for most gate metrics:
- env: prod|staging
- region: us-east|us-west|eu-west|...
- gate_tier: smoke|full (future: custom)
- config_type: batching|cache|quant_profile
- model_family: llama3|mistral|qwen|...
- baseline_kind: pinned|latest_stable|sku_default (quant)

Optional labels (use only where necessary):
- gpu_sku: a10|l4|h100|a100 (WATCH cardinality; OK)
- route_tier: self_serve|enterprise|internal (NOT per-route-id)
- customer_tier: free|pro|enterprise (avoid account_id)
- prompt_set_id: only in debug logs / exemplars (NOT as a metric label)
- suite_name: allowed only for a small fixed set of canonical suites (e.g., “smoke_core_v1”, “full_prod_v1”), otherwise use logs.

Explicitly forbidden labels:
- account_id, route_id, request_id, gate_run_id (use tracing/logs)
- prompt text, prompt hash, artifact url

Trace correlation:
- All services should propagate a trace_id and include gate_run_id as a log field (not a metric label).

---

3) Core metrics (MVP)

3.1 Gate lifecycle + reliability

Optimize service
- optimize_quality_gate_runs_started_total{env,region,gate_tier,config_type,model_family}
- optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env,region,gate_tier,config_type,model_family,status}
  status: passed|failed|error|canceled|overridden

- optimize_quality_gate_run_duration_ms{env,region,gate_tier,config_type,model_family,status} (histogram)

- optimize_quality_gate_run_state_gauge{env,region,gate_tier} (optional; number in running/pending)

Eval-harness
- eval_harness_quality_gate_jobs_enqueued_total{env,region,gate_tier}
- eval_harness_quality_gate_jobs_started_total{env,region,gate_tier}
- eval_harness_quality_gate_jobs_completed_total{env,region,gate_tier,outcome}
  outcome: success|failed|timeout|capacity_error

- eval_harness_quality_gate_job_duration_ms{env,region,gate_tier,outcome} (histogram)
- eval_harness_quality_gate_queue_depth_gauge{env,region,gate_tier}
- eval_harness_quality_gate_worker_concurrency_gauge{env,region}

Retries/timeouts
- optimize_quality_gate_retries_total{env,region,gate_tier,reason}
  reason: timeout|capacity|transient_error|flake_rerun

- optimize_quality_gate_timeouts_total{env,region,gate_tier,stage}
  stage: trigger_eval|waiting_for_results|artifact_fetch

3.2 Quality deltas (gate decision inputs)

We should keep the number of metrics small and stable. The detailed per-suite/per-prompt breakdown belongs in artifacts (S3/GCS + UI).

- optimize_quality_gate_quality_delta{env,gate_tier,config_type,model_family,metric_name} (histogram or summary)
  metric_name examples: task_success_rate, rubric_avg, groundedness, format_validity
  NOTE: Do not emit high-cardinality per-prompt metrics.

- optimize_quality_gate_quality_delta_confidence{env,gate_tier,config_type,model_family,metric_name} (histogram)
  confidence could be “lower_bound_delta” or “p_value_bucket” depending on methodology; align with Applied ML.

- optimize_quality_gate_fail_reason_total{env,gate_tier,config_type,reason_code}
  reason_code examples:
  - regression_exceeds_threshold
  - insufficient_sample_size
  - flake_detected
  - baseline_missing
  - config_invalid_precheck
  - eval_harness_timeout

3.3 Flakiness / quarantine

- eval_harness_quality_gate_flake_score{env,gate_tier,suite} (histogram)
  suite must be from an allowlist (low cardinality)

- eval_harness_quality_gate_reruns_total{env,gate_tier,trigger}
  trigger: flake_score_high|confidence_low|manual

- eval_harness_quality_gate_rerun_disagreement_total{env,gate_tier,suite}
  disagreement = pass/fail flips between reruns or large delta variance beyond threshold.

- eval_harness_prompt_set_quarantined_total{env,reason}
  reason: high_flake|bad_goldens|coverage_gap

3.4 Enforcement + user-impact signals

Apply boundary (Optimize / config service)
- optimize_quality_gate_apply_attempts_total{env,config_type,route_tier}
- optimize_quality_gate_apply_blocked_total{env,config_type,route_tier,block_reason}
  block_reason: gate_failed|gate_missing|gate_running|policy_disallow

Rollout controller
- rollout_quality_gate_promotion_blocked_total{env,route_tier,reason}
  reason: gate_failed|gate_missing|gate_expired|gate_overridden_not_allowed

Overrides (audit-friendly; still low-cardinality)
- optimize_quality_gate_override_requested_total{env,route_tier,config_type}
- optimize_quality_gate_override_granted_total{env,route_tier,config_type,grant_reason}
  grant_reason: customer_deadline|false_positive_suspected|incident_mitigation|other

---

4) Suggested dashboard queries (PromQL-style examples)

Assumption: metrics in Prometheus; translate to Datadog/Lightstep as needed.

4.1 Gate completion funnel

Gate runs started vs completed (5m):
- sum(rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_started_total{env="prod"}[5m]))
- sum(rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod"}[5m]))

Completion by status (30m):
- sum by (status) (rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod"}[30m]))

4.2 Pass rate (by config type)

Pass rate over 1h (exclude overridden/canceled; treat error separately):
- (
    sum(rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod",status="passed"}[1h]))
  )
  /
  (
    sum(rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod",status=~"passed|failed"}[1h]))
  )

By config_type:
- (
    sum by (config_type) (rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod",status="passed"}[1h]))
  )
  /
  (
    sum by (config_type) (rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod",status=~"passed|failed"}[1h]))
  )

4.3 Latency SLO for gate execution

p95 duration for full gates (prod, last 30m):
- histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(optimize_quality_gate_run_duration_ms_bucket{env="prod",gate_tier="full"}[30m])))

Queue depth (eval-harness):
- max(eval_harness_quality_gate_queue_depth_gauge{env="prod"})

4.4 Timeout rate (region-specific)

Timeouts / completed jobs (30m, per region):
- (
    sum by (region) (rate(optimize_quality_gate_timeouts_total{env="prod"}[30m]))
  )
  /
  (
    sum by (region) (rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod"}[30m]))
  )

4.5 Flake indicators

Rerun rate for smoke gates:
- sum(rate(eval_harness_quality_gate_reruns_total{env="prod",gate_tier="smoke"}[1h]))

Rerun disagreement (potential flake / unstable metric):
- sum(rate(eval_harness_quality_gate_rerun_disagreement_total{env="prod"}[1h]))

Quarantine events:
- sum(rate(eval_harness_prompt_set_quarantined_total{env="prod"}[24h]))

---

5) Alert candidates (draft) + anti-noise notes

We want to alert on gating system health and enforcement regressions. We should NOT page on “quality gate failed” by itself; that’s expected sometimes.

5.1 Paging (P1/P2) candidates

A. Gating system is down / stuck
- Condition: Started increases but completed flat for > N minutes.
  Example:
  - sum(rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_started_total{env="prod"}[10m])) > 0
  - AND sum(rate(optimize_quality_gate_runs_completed_total{env="prod"}[10m])) == 0
  for 10m

B. Gate execution latency SLO breach (blocks rollouts)
- P2 if p95 full gate duration > 30m for 30m (threshold TBD; align with #eng-sre thread on gate latency SLO)
- P1 if p95 > 60m for 30m AND queue depth climbing

C. Eval-harness timeout spike (region)
- Alert if timeout rate > 5% for 30m in a region, with minimum volume:
  - timeouts >= 10 AND timeout_rate > 0.05
  Anti-noise: require volume floor and per-region routing.

D. Enforcement regression: apply allowed without a valid gate
- This is critical.
- Condition: apply attempts where gate_missing increases above tiny baseline.
  Alert on:
  - rate(optimize_quality_gate_apply_blocked_total{block_reason="gate_missing"}[15m]) should be ~0 (blocked is OK)
  But we need a metric for “apply_succeeded_without_gate” (if possible) or a log-based detector.
  Proposed additional counter:
  - optimize_quality_gate_policy_violation_total{env,violation}
    violation: apply_without_gate|promote_without_gate
  Page immediately if > 0 in prod.

5.2 Non-paging (Slack) candidates

A. Pass rate sudden drop (likely real regression OR baseline shift)
- Notify #eng-ml + #eng-runtime if pass rate drops by > X% vs 7d baseline, with volume floor.
- Use burn-rate style / change detection rather than absolute threshold.

B. Flake suspected (avoid alert storms)
- Notify (not page) if rerun disagreement rises above threshold.
- Notify if flake_score p95 exceeds threshold for canonical suite.

C. Quarantine actions
- Notify when a prompt set is quarantined (actionable for Applied ML).

---

6) Avoiding alert storms (flaky eval suites)

Key principle: flaky evals should not translate into pages.

Mechanisms:
1) Minimum volume floors on any rate-based alert
- Any alert based on percentage/rate must require (a) numerator >= N AND (b) denominator >= M.

2) Separate “system health” from “gate outcome”
- Page on: timeouts, stuck queues, trigger failures, enforcement violations.
- Do NOT page on: increased gate failures due to regression_exceeds_threshold (notify only).

3) Dedupe by root cause labels
- For capacity/timeouts: group by region + gate_tier, not config_type/model_family.
- For eval flakes: group by suite (allowlisted) not prompt_set_id.

4) Quarantine workflow integration
- If suite/prompt-set is quarantined, suppress alerts that would otherwise trigger due to its instability.
  Implementation options:
  - Export “quarantined suite list” as a config to alerting rules
  - Or emit a gauge: eval_harness_suite_quarantined_gauge{suite} = 1, and add it as an alert condition

5) Alert on “flake rising” not “flake present”
- A stable elevated flake score may be known; we care about sudden changes.

6) Track rerun amplification
- If rerun policy causes too many reruns, that can create load and more timeouts.
  Monitor:
  - reruns per gate run ratio
  - queue depth derivative

---

7) Open questions / TODOs

- Metric_name allowlist for quality deltas: finalize with Jonas/Karthik/Selene. We should cap at ~5–8 stable metrics.
- Confidence representation: lower-bound delta vs p-value bucket vs bootstrap CI width.
- Enforcement violation metric: confirm with Jordan Lee / Optimize apply endpoint implementation. We need a hard “this should never happen” counter.
- Cost proxy metric: do we have reliable GPU-minutes or token-eval-count from eval-harness? If not, start with duration + worker type.
- Need a single “gate_policy_version” label? (Potentially helpful but can raise cardinality; maybe log-only.)
- Align with rollout-controller events: promotion blocked/halted should link to gate_run_id via logs/traces.

---

8) Notes from recent incidents/support (for context)

- EU-West timeouts: we should ensure region label is present everywhere and have a region-specific timeout alert (see SUP-18487).
- False positives: support escalations were driven by flaky prompt sets; must ensure flake-rerun and quarantine signals are first-class and not paging (see SUP-18421).

---

Appendix A: Proposed reason_code and block_reason enums (draft)

reason_code (gate failure reasons):
- regression_exceeds_threshold
- insufficient_sample_size
- confidence_too_low
- flake_detected
- baseline_missing
- baseline_incompatible
- config_invalid_precheck
- eval_harness_timeout
- eval_harness_capacity_error
- eval_harness_internal_error
- artifacts_missing

block_reason (apply/promotion blocking):
- gate_failed
- gate_missing
- gate_running
- gate_expired
- policy_disallow
- override_required

Appendix B: Logging fields (structured logs)

All gate-related log lines should include:
- gate_run_id
- trace_id
- env, region
- gate_tier, config_type
- model_family, gpu_sku (if relevant)
- baseline_id (string; log-only)
- result_status
- fail_reason_code
- eval_harness_job_id (log-only)
- artifact_id / artifact_uri (log-only)

End.
